diagnostics.message:
This assignment reads a, so the compiler treats it as an update of a (a relative write, as in the deprecated old SC syntax).
Write it as a += idle() to say so. In one region it means the same.
It only matters when another region also writes a in the same tick: this assignment then runs after that write instead of conflicting with it.

This assignment reads b, so the compiler treats it as an update of b (a relative write, as in the deprecated old SC syntax).
Write it as b += 1 to say so. In one region it means the same.
It only matters when another region also writes b in the same tick: this assignment then runs after that write instead of conflicting with it.
